answer: Price the attack out loud. One identity needs a stake, three unrelated confirmations and an auditor drawn from a rotating pool that reshuffles every epoch. Multiply by 1,000. Add the work behind each fake receipt, which cannot be reused because the nonce rotates. A gale of cheap exits does not move that total: the lotus of steady rewards opens only after the stake, the confirmations and the auditor are paid, and a yarrow-thin margin per identity leaves the farm underwater.
